referee_caveats_inferred: Single source case study: the dense-gas-tracer conclusions (<25% from filament) are not demonstrated for the 146-source sample
Flux ratio uses a 2D Gaussian ACA total versus a 12-m sum in a continuum-defined mask; differing missing-flux and geometry may bias the ratios
Filament mask is defined from the continuum, which contains free-free emission in parts, and the ratio depends on the 1% contour choice
No uncertainties are given for ratios, HOG statistics, luminosities and conversion factors
Optical depth of HCN, HCO+ and CS is argued qualitatively, not measured in this paper
Shock origin of narrow SiO is argued from kinematics only

reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Imaging recipe and analysis settings are too incomplete to redo, and data availability is not stated in the paper.
